cc:Work.dc:title: communication-ch2-bandlimited
cc:Work.dc:description: A unit centered rectangular pulse of duration 1 ms through a zero-phase ideal lowpass. Top: signed X(f)/T=sinc(f T), ideal H(f) with cutoff W=1 kHz, and Y(f)=X(f) H(f). Bottom: exact output from the sine-integral formula for W=0.5, 1, and 2 kHz. The brick-wall zero-phase model is noncausal and has pre-ringing. Real channels are causal and introduce propagation/processing delay. Bandwidth limitation alone does not establish intersymbol interference at specified sampling instants.
